svg.title: Warden: orchestrated agents for access reviews
svg.desc: Flow diagram: 1,922 access lines go through a rules engine with no AI, which decides 159 risks; the 23 that hinge on a ticket go to an investigator agent (Claude Sonnet) that must quote the ticket, a code check that verifies every quote, and a challenger agent (Claude Opus) that argues back; a briefer agent (Claude Haiku) summarises for the manager, who decides, and IT executes in Freshservice. 182 of 182 planted risks found, 0 false alarms, 23 of 23 agent calls verified.
